prompt:
You run weekly onboarding A/B tests. Here is every finished test so far: what you predicted
and what was measured.

- round 1: Move Sign-In after Adoption Selection [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +10.0%, measured +5.5% (p=0.001819), won
- round 1: Clear Desktop Spawning Instructions on Home Intro [finish, copy]: predicted +12.0%, measured -0.6% (p=0.859488), lost: no clear effect
- round 1: Live Generation Progress & Tip Carousel on Waiting Screen [home, wait_info]: predicted +6.0%, measured +4.0% (p=0.05138), lost: no clear effect
- round 1: Centered Mascot Intro on Story Screen [choose_path, layout]: predicted +4.0%, measured +0.1% (p=0.950748), rolled back: guardrail
- round 2: Story Screen Narrative Carousel Redesign [choose_path, redesign]: predicted +1.0%, measured -2.2% (p=0.12914), lost: no clear effect
- round 2: Desktop Ready Background Notification Prompt [home, notification]: predicted +4.0%, measured +5.1% (p=0.01156), won
- round 2: Clear Account Recovery Warning on Sign-In Screen [sign_in, copy]: predicted +1.5%, measured -0.3% (p=0.844378), lost: no clear effect
- round 2: Desktop Overlay Controls Quick Hint on Home Intro [finish, hint]: predicted +1.0%, measured -0.4% (p=0.896587), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Place Sign-In After Adoption Certificate [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +5.5%, measured -22.4% (p=0.000126), stopped early: sign_in worse
- round 3: Split Screen Pick Friend Experience [adoption, redesign]: predicted -2.2%, measured -17.2% (p=0.000235), stopped early: adoption worse
- round 3: Desktop Spawn Readiness Sound Cue [home, notification]: predicted +5.1%, measured +1.3% (p=0.514279), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Value Proposition Headline on Path Selection [choose_path, copy]: predicted +0.0%, measured +0.4% (p=0.763836), lost: no clear effect
- round 4: Redesign Upload Photos Screen with Structured Dropzone [adoption, redesign]: predicted -15.0%, measured -4.5% (p=0.092402), lost: no clear effect
- round 4: Reorder Sign-In After Photo Upload [sign_in, reorder]: predicted -8.0%, measured +3.3% (p=0.039166), won
- round 4: Estimated Generation Time Display on Waiting Screen [home, wait_info]: predicted +3.5%, measured -3.2% (p=0.087269), lost: no clear effect
- round 4: Background Tray Notification Enable Toggle on Home Intro [finish, notification]: predicted +4.5%, measured -1.6% (p=0.60515), lost: no clear effect
- round 4: Path Selection Helper Hint [choose_path, hint]: predicted +0.2%, measured +3.5% (p=0.012467), won

Previous lessons:
Moving sign-in after adoption selection was helpful (+5.5%), but reordering sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Desktop ready background notification prompts were helpful (+5.1%), but sound cue notifications showed no clear effect.
Copy updates, overlay hints, and headline changes showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen progress indicators and tip carousels showed no clear effect.
Layout tweaks and visual redesigns showed no clear effect and risk severe negative drops or guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions were mostly over-optimistic, though the background notification prompt was slightly under-predicted (+4.0% predicted vs +5.1% measured).

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Reordering sign-in can be helpful (won after adoption selection at +5.5% and photo upload at +3.3%), but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).

Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1%) and path selection helper hints (+3.3%) were helpful, but sound cue notifications, notification toggles, and desktop overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Copy updates and waiting screen progress/time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Visual redesigns and layout changes showed no clear effect or caused severe negative drops (-17.2%) and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions were frequently over-optimistic for non-winning tests, predicting up to +12.0% where no clear effect was measured.
Predictions underestimated several wins, such as sign-in reordering after photo upload (-8.0% predicted vs +3.3% measured) and path helper hints (+0.2% predicted vs +3.5% measured).
